newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Kidston says second qtr loss widens. [CORRECTED 3:25 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Kidston says second qtr loss widens. [CORRECTED 3:25 GMT]

text.p: Kidston Gold Mines Ltd said on Wednesday that its second quarter net loss widened to A$2.24 million from a loss of A$309,000 a year earlier.

The company, which is 70 percent owned by Placer Dome Inc and has operations in the state of Queensland, said it made a net loss of A$3.93 million in the six months to June 30, against a profit of A$5.06 million in the 1996 first half.
It said the quarterly loss was due to a fall in average gold price to A$557 an ounce from A$624 a year earlier and costs associated with the stripping programme at the Eldridge pit.
